verdict.rationale: The evidence documents client-executed function calling in the Voice Agent API and an MCP server built into the dg CLI for AI coding tools. That server serves Deepgram APIs to other agents; it does not let the voice agent consume MCP servers as tool sources. Nothing shows the voice agent connecting to external MCP servers to load whole toolsets mid-call, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
